name: znetwork_init_message_handlers
description: zNetwork::InitMessageHandlers initializes the global dispatch-handler sentinel list and registers its CRT atexit shutdown callback.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork dispatch-list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x48bfa0 validates a no-argument call to zNetwork::CreateEmptyDispatchHandlerList followed by a tailcall to zNetwork::RegisterDispatchHandlerListShutdown.

Existing functional target znetwork_create_empty_dispatch_handler_list validates the sentinel allocation, self-linking, global store, and handler-count reset reached through zNetwork_InitMessageHandlers.
Existing functional target znetwork_register_dispatch_handler_list_shutdown validates the tail-called CRT atexit registration wrapper and callback target.

Native smoke znetwork_dispatch_handler_list_smoke calls zNetwork_InitMessageHandlers, verifies the self-linked global sentinel and zero dispatch-handler count, then exercises delete-all and shutdown cleanup behavior.
